item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las sbyin sregs dus mtha'i me dpung
item.coloph: ces 'jigs byed gshin rje khros pa'i rgyud las/ drag po'i sbyin sregs (sreg)dus mtha'i me dpung 'di ni/ bstan pa bshigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra 'ga' yi rkyen gyi (gyis) nye bar bskul ngor/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor ba/ kun grol grags par 'bod pa bdag gi skyes bdag ces pa lcags lug hor zla gsum pa'i dmar phyogs su/ shar rdza phyug mo dpal ri'i mdun zhol la 'khor dga' ldan dar rgyas gling gi mgon khang du gshin rje sgrub pa'i thun mtshams su bgyis pa bstan dgra'i srog gshed du gyur cig//
